items.title: Buyer beware? Nvidia's volatile swings expose risks of single-stock ETFs
items.summary: Nvidia 's latest bout of volatility is highlighting risks tied to single-stock exchange-traded funds. Among the hardest hit: the GraniteShares 2x Short NVDA Daily ETF (NVD) .

items.title: Semiconductor chips are the new oil. Here's why
items.summary: The artificial intelligence boom has pushed semiconductors past oil and gas in global export value for the first time, according to a Deutsche Bank analysis of International Trade Centre data .

items.title: Robots could be doing household chores in just 1-2 years, Chinese EV firm says
items.summary: BEIJING — The household robot could soon become a reality, Brian Gu, co-president of Xpeng , a Chinese electric car company which has entered the humanoids space, told CNBC.

items.title: Beware higher correlation but nab high U.S. credit yields, fund managers say
items.summary: The artificial intelligence boom could lead to a recession, whether through a collapse in AI investment or widespread job losses as the technology advances, a hedge fund manager said.

items.title: Prediction markets push OpenAI IPO expectations later into 2027
items.summary: Anthropic's shaky performance on the public markets since its debut last week and a continuing tech sell-off may be changing the outlook for when prediction markets think OpenAI will go public.

items.title: Spain’s Pablo Hernández de Cos set to lead European Central Bank
items.summary: Pablo Hernández de Cos is set to succeed Christine Lagarde as president of the European Central Bank next year.

items.title: U.S. tariff-hike threats pile pressure on partners to sign trade deals
items.summary: The Trump administration has unveiled a fresh tariff salvo on more than a dozen trading partners, with China, Vietnam, and India facing some of the steepest potential rates and mounting pressure to conclude trade deals with Washington.

items.title: I’m terrified of a market crash. Should I put $400,000 of my $1 million retirement savings into an annuity?
I hate that Jensen Huang is back at Nvidia, but I love what it’s done for my 401(k). Am I a hypocrite?
A 66-year-old nurse is facing down retirement with just $500 saved. Who’s to blame?
